_about: Published NIST/CFTT results, transcribed verbatim from the DHS test reports. These are NOT our measurements: NIST ran these tools, on NIST hardware, on the CFReDS 'File Carving Graphic Files' (2023) corpus. We reproduce them only so our own numbers can sit beside them with the provenance made explicit. Every 'verdict' field below is a direct quote or a close paraphrase of the report's Observations and Anomalies section.
_layout_note: Every CFTT layout is fragmented IN ORDER. Out-of-order fragmentation is not covered by this benchmark at all.
_test_design: Six source files per format per layout. Formats: HEIC, PNG, JPG, BMP, TIFF, GIF. Layouts: contiguous (sector-aligned), non-aligned, fragmented (sector-aligned, benign fill inserted between fragments).
_we_cannot_rerun: We hold no licences for AXIOM, FTK, Forensic Explorer or R-Studio, so these rows can never be re-measured by us. Treat them as cited literature, not as experimental results of ours.
